segments.content:
Chapter 260 0257 Give Each Auntie a Set of Sanguo Sha

The male executive and the female white-collar worker from last year had already become very, very, very good friends.

Their friendship blossomed because of Chen Guiliang's book, so they chose not to join the white-collar-packed Bilin Wang, but registered accounts on Hainei Wang instead.

They often shared their work and life on Hainei Wang, occasionally posting about their experiences and thoughts on reading, traveling, and playing tennis.

This year, hearing that Chen Guiliang was holding another book signing, they arranged to come together.

"What's going on up ahead?"

"I don't know. It looks like someone's here to cause trouble."

"You wait here in line, I'll go have a look."

"Be careful. Don't get involved."

The male executive left the queue and walked toward the aunties, only to see them all heading collectively for the signing table. He followed them until he was stopped by the staff.

He wasn't far from the signing table here, close enough to hear what was being said, so he stood where he was, waiting to see what the commotion was about.

Chen Guiliang glanced up before continuing to sign books for his fans.

After the aunties and reporters swarmed the signing table, they chattered nonstop. One person said this, another said that, like 500 ducks quacking away.

Seeing Chen Guiliang ignore them, one auntie said angrily, "What's with your attitude? Why are you ignoring us?"

"Exactly, say something!"

"He won't even look at us."

Chen Guiliang turned to look at them, and they started talking all over again.

They were completely disorganized, each speaking for herself, with at least seven or eight of them talking at once.

Chen Guiliang remained calm and continued signing, no longer looking at them.

How could he communicate in this situation?

Li Xunhuan shouted, "Quiet, quiet! Can you please speak one at a time? Choose a representative to speak first! How can we talk with all this racket?"

The aunties kept chattering away.

Li Xunhuan's scalp tingled as he listened, his head about to explode.

Seeing Chen Guiliang ignore them again, one auntie tried to rush forward and snatch the pen from his hand.

Yang Shuo, who had been on alert, immediately blocked her.

But Yang Shuo didn't dare use force, merely spreading his arms to block her, terrified that if anything went wrong, the auntie would just lie down on the ground.

After five or six minutes, thanks to the efforts of Li Xunhuan and the reporters, the aunties finally agreed to speak one by one.

The first auntie came to the side of the signing table.

Chen Guiliang stood up and smiled as he shook her hand. "Hello, Ma'am. I'm Chen Guiliang."

The auntie was taken aback for a moment, not expecting Chen Guiliang's attitude to be so good.

She shook his hand instinctively, then remembered the purpose of her visit and said in an unfriendly tone, "Who are you calling 'Ma'am'? I'm old enough to be your mother."

"You look so young, I thought you were only 30. Your child must still be in elementary school, right?" Chen Guiliang said.

The auntie couldn't help but smile, her tone softening slightly. "Don't think a few nice words will make me support you people who make games."

Chen Guiliang said, "Now, now. What's wrong with me speaking a little truth? You really do look like you're thirty. You've taken such good care of yourself, your skin is like a young girl's."

Chen Guiliang was rather handsome, and a celebrity to boot.

After that round of compliments, the auntie's aggressive momentum had mostly dissipated. "I just want to have it out with you. You're clearly a student from Peking University, you have a very bright future. Why do you have to go and make games?"

Chen Guiliang asked in return, "The game I made is called 'Sanguo Sha.' Are you familiar with this game?"

The auntie said with unfounded certainty, "How could I not be? The name itself sounds like it's all about fighting and killing. Kids play as those generals from the Three Kingdoms, killing each other in your game all day long. Those children from laid-off worker families, and the left-behind children in the countryside, their families are already not well-off, and they still steal their parents' money to buy equipment in your game. Oh, and they have to charge up some point cards too."

Chen Guiliang explained patiently, "Ma'am, 'Sanguo Sha' doesn't sell point cards, and there's no equipment in the game."

"How is that possible?" an auntie in the outer circle couldn't help but say.

"That's right, all online games these days sell point cards and equipment! My son didn't eat breakfast for half a year, he spent all his meal money on point cards. I only found out at the end of the semester."

"Denying it right to our faces. You game developers are all so shameless!"

They had agreed to take turns asking questions, but the aunties started chattering chaotically again.

Chen Guiliang said to the auntie in front of him, "Ma'am, how am I supposed to talk with all of you like this?"

This particular auntie, having just been complimented, wasn't as angry anymore. She took the initiative to go talk to her companions, and after several more minutes, everyone finally fell silent again.

Chen Guiliang explained, "There are many different types of online games. It's like how soccer, basketball, and table tennis are all ball sports, but can their rules be the same? Poker, mahjong, Chinese chess, and Go, can they be the same? Sanguo Sha wasn't originally an online game, but a tabletop game."

Chen Guiliang called out to the fans in line, "Did anyone else bring a copy of Sanguo Sha to be signed?"

"Me!"

A student stepped forward.

Chen Guiliang asked the student to come over, opened his Sanguo Sha box, and distributed the cards inside for the aunties to see.

They were physical cards, and the generals all had their base skins, none of which were drawn too revealingly.

"This is Sanguo Sha?"

"I think so. The back of the cards says 'Sanguo Sha'."

"Why is it a set of playing cards with little people drawn on them?"

"The online game must be different, they just have the same name."

These aunties started chattering away again.

Chen Guiliang looked at the student and reassured him, "Don't worry, if they get damaged, I'll compensate you. Leave an address, and I'll mail you a signed collector's edition."

"Really?" The student grew excited.

Chen Guiliang handed him a pen and paper. "Write down your address."

As the student wrote his address, he said, "CEO Chen, I really admire you. Because of 'Sanguo Sha' and 'Those Things in the Ming Dynasty,' I fell in love with history. I'm going to major in history when I go to college."

Chen Guiliang offered some well-intentioned advice, "You can still study history without majoring in it. You could major in another popular field and read history books in your spare time."

"You don't need to persuade me, I'm definitely going to major in history!" The student's attitude was firm.

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: Does this count as leading someone astray?

The aunties were still making a scene. Li Xunhuan shouted repeatedly, "Stop arguing, speak one at a time. Raise your hand if you want to speak, otherwise we'll never get this sorted out today!"

Quite a few fans had left the queue and gathered nearby to watch the spectacle. The staff could barely hold them back.

"Are you all crazy? You have nothing better to do?"

"If you've got guts, go make a scene at Shanda, NetEase, or The9. What's the point of bullying a small company here?"

"Call the police, get them out of here! They're holding up our signing!"

The aunties hadn't quieted down, and now the fans started yelling at them.

A few of the aunties were provoked and started a shouting match with the fans from across the line of staff.

More and more people from both sides joined the fray.

Chen Guiliang and Li Xunhuan hurriedly ran to the middle to mediate.

Li Xunhuan had already called the police, and soon, the officers arrived on the scene.

Under the officers' coordination, the aunties finally agreed to speak in turn again, and the fans promised not to curse at them anymore.

The reporters on the scene were thrilled. Although they were all from newspaper lifestyle sections and web portal book channels, besides writing culture-related news, they could also moonlight and write other kinds of reports.

Moreover, news happening at a book signing, especially one related to online games, was the kind of report that could be published in the lifestyle section and book channel.

An officer pointed to an auntie to ask a question. "I'm very familiar with online games, don't you try to fool me. You make money by selling point cards and equipment. How else would you make money? Is your company a charity?"

Chen Guiliang said, "You won't believe anything I say. This is a student who came to get his book signed. Let's have him explain."

The student was quite excited. "Aunties, 'Sanguo Sha' really doesn't sell point cards or equipment. Take me for example, I play 'Sanguo Sha' online too. But over the past year, I've only spent 80 yuan, which was to buy some powerful generals that require a lot of Hero Soul fragments. There are even people who have played for a year without spending a single cent, and in fact, most players don't spend money."

"Don't team up to lie to me, this student is your fan!" The auntie was still unconvinced.

Chen Guiliang sighed and asked, "Have you ever played Dou Dizhu online?"

The auntie shook her head. "No."

"Ladies, since you've all added each other to a QQ group, you can be considered netizens. Nowadays, it's very fashionable for middle-aged people to use QQ. Surely some of you must have played Dou Dizhu in the QQ Game Hall?" Chen Guiliang said.

More than one or two of the aunties had played QQ Dou Dizhu. Disregarding their agreement with the officer, they chattered, "QQ Dou Dizhu isn't the same as an online game. That's for casual fun, you can play it without paying!"

Chen Guiliang looked at the officer, who stepped forward again to quiet everyone down.

Finally, Chen Guiliang explained, "'Sanguo Sha' is quite similar to QQ Dou Dizhu. They're both a type of card game, and you can choose to pay or not to pay. Just like you all, you can play QQ Dou Dizhu without paying. But you can also pay to buy 'Happy Beans'."

The aunties started chattering again, and this time even the officer got angry.

The officer yelled, "No more shouting! You... yes, you. You're the loudest. You talk, everyone else be quiet."

The auntie with the loudest voice said, "I've played QQ Dou Dizhu. You can't spend money on QQ Dou Dizhu, you're lying to us!"

Chen Guiliang was rendered speechless by this statement. "Ma'am, QQ Dou Dizhu introduced the 'Happy Beans' system last year. You can play for free, but others can also pay to play. My 'Sanguo Sha' is the same. They're both card games, and you can choose to pay or not. My company makes money from the ones who do pay."

"You speak!" The officer pointed to another auntie.

The auntie said, "Regardless of whether you pay or not, whether you sell point cards and equipment or not, the fact is you're harming students by making online games. You lure students into internet cafes, and they spend all day in there playing games instead of studying."

"That's right, all of you game developers are harming people!"

"The government should just arrest you all!"

The officer was about to go crazy. "Don't shout. I'll call on who gets to speak! You go..."

That auntie said, "I'm done."

The officer said, "Then it's Mr. Chen's turn to speak."

Chen Guiliang explained, "You don't have to play games in internet cafes. I haven't even sent people to internet cafes to promote it. In fact, many internet cafes nowadays don't have 'Sanguo Sha' installed. If students want to play Sanguo Sha at an internet cafe, they have to download it themselves. You can go to any 10 internet cafes in Beijing to verify this. If more than 5 of them have Sanguo Sha installed, then you can say I'm in the wrong and am corrupting students. In other cities, even fewer internet cafes have Sanguo Sha installed."

The officer quickly interjected this time, "Don't argue, I'll call on people. Let's not get stuck on this question. If you don't believe him, you can go check the internet cafes right now."

The aunties looked at each other, not knowing what else to say.

"Hahaha!"

The fans who were watching the commotion suddenly burst out laughing.

Chen Guiliang took the opportunity to say, "According to our company's data, the average daily playtime for a 'Sanguo Sha' player used to be 45 minutes, and has now increased to about an hour. Playing a game for an hour a day can't be considered an addiction, can it? Students can play basketball for that long."

This, of course, wasn't the whole truth.

The average playtime was only an hour, but it was perfectly normal for hardcore players to play for half a day at a time.

But he truly had never heard of anyone skipping class to play 'Sanguo Sha.'

Just as the officer was about to let the aunties speak, Chen Guiliang continued, "How about this. To all the ladies who came here today, I will gift each of you a physical set of 'Sanguo Sha' cards. You can take them home and study the game for yourselves. If you don't like it, you can just throw it away."

He then added, "If your children are addicted to other games, you can try letting them play 'Sanguo Sha.' Maybe if they come to like it, they'll stop skipping class to play games and will only play for a bit in their spare time."

After saying this, Chen Guiliang called Youke's warehouse manager. "This is Chen Guiliang. Immediately send 20 sets of cards to Dongfang Xintiandi. When you get there, just ask for Chen Guiliang's new book signing and you'll find it."

It wasn't just the aunties; Chen Guiliang even planned on giving a set to the officer.

Li Xunhuan had already sent his staff to a nearby shop to bring over coffee and stools, arranging for the aunties to sit and have a drink.

Chen Guiliang went back to signing books.

The officer didn't dare to leave, afraid that trouble might erupt again.

The aunties started chatting while drinking their coffee:

"Could it be that we really misunderstood him?"

"He probably wouldn't lie, right? Maybe we should go to an internet cafe later to ask?"

"I don't think he's lying, otherwise he wouldn't have been on the 'Xinwen Lianbo' news broadcast."

"That's what I said. How could an online game be featured on 'Xinwen Lianbo'? I was skeptical before we came, but you all insisted on egging me on."

"What do you mean, we egged you on? You were just as worked up, you were even cursing in the QQ group!"

"If it's really similar to QQ Dou Dizhu, then it's no big deal to play a little."

"So we came all this way for nothing today?"

"Why don't we go line up and buy a book? I heard it's a popular history book, we can let the kids read it to cultivate their knowledge of history."

"Buy his book? Give him face? Even if 'Sanguo Sha' isn't addictive, he's still an online game developer! Even if he isn't making a kill-and-slash game now, he definitely will in the future."

"Right, it's more profitable to make those kill-and-slash games. He'll definitely do it. When he does, we'll come back and settle the score with him!"

The aunties were truly perceptive.

Unfortunately, their information was a bit outdated. They didn't yet know that Chen Guiliang had invested in 'Quan Yu Tian Xia.'

After a while, the Youke employee arrived with 20 sets of physical cards.

One set for each person. Everyone who came got one, including the officer.

Only then did the aunties leave together, feeling the trip had not been in vain and that they hadn't come for nothing. The Sanguo Sha sets in their hands were like free eggs they got from the supermarket.

It didn't matter if it was useful at home or not; the fact was they had received something.

The box contained an instruction manual that taught them step-by-step how to play in person. It was possible that one of the aunties here today would go home and play a 1v1 match with her husband that very night.

Of course, a few of the aunties really did go to find an internet cafe to inquire about the situation.

Li Xunhuan heaved a long sigh of relief. "It's finally settled. CEO Chen, do you think someone's unhappy with you and deliberately incited them to come here?"

"Only the devil knows," Chen Guiliang said, busy with his signing.

(End of this chapter)
